<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#E6E6E5"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="36" fill="#E6E6E5"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <text x="22" y="23" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#2C2929">9:41</text>
  <line x1="327" y1="21" x2="327" y2="16" stroke="#2C2929" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="332" y1="21" x2="332" y2="13" stroke="#2C2929" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="337" y1="21" x2="337" y2="10" stroke="#2C2929" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="348" cy="16" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#2C2929" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="350" y1="18" x2="354" y2="22" stroke="#2C2929" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="363" y="11" width="20" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#2C2929" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="365" y="13" width="14" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#2C2929"/>
  <rect x="383" y="14" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#2C2929"/>

  <!-- header -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="30" cy="70" r="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="22" y1="66" x2="38" y2="66" stroke="#2C2929" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="22" y1="71" x2="38" y2="71" stroke="#2C2929" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="22" y1="76" x2="38" y2="76" stroke="#2C2929" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="78" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Georgia, Merriweather, serif" font-size="27" font-weight="700" font-style="italic" fill="#ED1B24">Coca-Cola</text>
  <circle cx="360" cy="70" r="18" fill="#000000"/>
  <circle cx="360" cy="65" r="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <ellipse cx="360" cy="76" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- sign in content -->
  <text x="195" y="139" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="36" font-weight="700" fill="#2C2929">Sign in</text>
  <text x="195" y="165" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#2C2929">Welcome back to the Coca-Cola community</text>

  <!-- Apple button shadow -->
  <rect x="43" y="190" width="305" height="58" rx="24" fill="#000000" opacity="0.10"/>
  <g>
    <rect x="43" y="187" width="305" height="58" rx="24" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="92" cy="215" r="8" fill="#000000"/>
    <circle cx="98" cy="207" r="4" fill="#000000"/>
    <ellipse cx="92" cy="220" rx="8" ry="7" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="195" y="222" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Continue with Apple</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Google button -->
  <rect x="43" y="263" width="305" height="58" rx="24" fill="#000000" opacity="0.10"/>
  <g>
    <rect x="43" y="260" width="305" height="58" rx="24" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="92" cy="289" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#ED1B24" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="92" y1="289" x2="102" y2="289" stroke="#ED1B24" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="92" y1="279" x2="92" y2="283" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="84" y1="294" x2="88" y2="297" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3"/>
    <text x="195" y="295" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Continue with Google</text>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="354" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#2C2929">or sign in with your work email</text>

  <!-- email field -->
  <text x="43" y="391" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#2C2929">WORK EMAIL</text>
  <rect x="43" y="400" width="305" height="58" rx="24" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="429" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#2C2929" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polyline points="61,425 68,431 75,425" fill="none" stroke="#2C2929" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="88" y="435" font-family="Avenir LT Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#777777">you@company.com</text>
  <text x="43" y="478" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#555555">We'll send a secure sign-up link to this address.</text>

  <!-- CTA -->
  <rect x="43" y="497" width="305" height="58" rx="24" fill="#000000" opacity="0.12"/>
  <g>
    <rect x="43" y="493" width="305" height="58" rx="24" fill="#ED1B24"/>
    <text x="195" y="529" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Email me a sign-up link</text>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="590" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#2C2929">Already have an account? <tspan fill="#ED1B24" font-weight="700">Log in</tspan></text>

  <!-- terms card -->
  <rect x="43" y="620" width="305" height="76" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.65"/>
  <circle cx="69" cy="647" r="11" fill="#ED1B24"/>
  <polyline points="64,647 68,651 75,643" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="90" y="644" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#2C2929">By continuing, you agree to our</text>
  <text x="90" y="663" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#ED1B24">Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.</text>
  <line x1="90" y1="666" x2="242" y2="666" stroke="#ED1B24" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="752" width="390" height="92" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="752" x2="390" y2="752" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,779 50,770 61,779 61,792 54,792 54,783 46,783 46,792 39,792" fill="#ED1B24"/>
    <text x="50" y="812" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Euclid Flex, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#ED1B24">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="127" cy="780" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#777777" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="134" y1="787" x2="141" y2="794" stroke="#777777" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="127" y="812" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Euclid Flex, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#777777">Explore</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="185" y="772" width="19" height="17" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#777777" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="189,789 189,794 195,789" fill="none" stroke="#777777" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="195" y="812" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Euclid Flex, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#777777">Community</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="276" cy="777" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#777777" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="276" cy="790" rx="12" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#777777" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="276" y="812" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Euclid Flex, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#777777">Profile</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="350" cy="780" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#777777" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="780" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#777777" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="350" y1="766" x2="350" y2="770" stroke="#777777" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="350" y1="790" x2="350" y2="794" stroke="#777777" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="350" y="812" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Euclid Flex, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#777777">Settings</text>
  </g>
  <rect x="158" y="829" width="74" height="5" rx="3" fill="#000000" opacity="0.18"/>
</svg>
